How fast did CORTIS reach 1.5 billion Spotify streams?

BigHit Music says the group passed 1.5 billion cumulative Spotify streams 15 months after debut, with about 1.2 billion of them coming in 2026.

Sources: The Korea Herald · Yonhap via The Korea Times
